title: The Museum of Uncertain Things · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (about 100 words) about a time when you were not sure about something. Use at least two that-clauses and one if-sentence. Explain what you did and what you learned.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
